_about: vafSOMA run configuration. Relative paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Results go to <outdir>/<experiment>/. See vafSOMA_docs/configuration.md.

input._about: variants: one VAF table per minimum-depth cutoff (directory, .zip or single table with a depth_filter column); effective_genome_size: table with tree, depth_filter, effective_genome_size; root2tip: table with sample, root2tip_length (length or age of each organ, measured from its divergence from the matched normal; used to choose the depth window and passed to the outputs). tree: label used when the tables carry no tree column. replicate_groups: table (tree, sample, group) or {tree: {sample: group}}. control_organs: {tree: organ or [organs]} used as matched normal upstream (flagged in the outputs; not used to choose the depth window).

model._about: layer_specific_seq false: bulk organs with layer_proportions; true: layer-enriched sample with active_layer (and its purity active_layer_proportion). vaf_phasing 'unphased' (collapsed diploid; mu = c/2) or 'phased' (mu = c). Template layer proportions: mean of published leaf compositions (as in the simSOMA layers template).

depth_window._about: selected: fixed window 'start:end' (e.g. '28:36'); null selects a stable window automatically.
